sourceScope: The fixture mounts the production styleguide and registered real DMenubar examples from the exact source commit. The copied bundle only changes its Info.plist identity and ad-hoc signature; repository runner identities and entitlements are unchanged.

inspection.note: Exact e3104c9a fixture accepted on native macOS: 360px/200%/reduced-motion LTR and RTL Profiles open and logical wrap to File preserve fully visible active triggers; popup navigation to Print scrolls only popup, Return selects Print. Plum custom RTL large text inspected. Arabic Share chevron points left; Left opens submenu to left, Right returns to parent. Official dark default/File and With Icons/More states compared; earlier official light and unchanged native command/checkbox/radio/typeahead/Escape evidence retained. Own app and browser tab closed and desktop lease released. Status/acceptance-text promotion does not change inspected runtime.
limitations: Native iOS/Linux devices and spoken VoiceOver were not tested.
